Are you a natural communicator who enjoys solving problems and making customers feel heard? Do you speak fluent English and Spanish? Then this Customer Service Representative role in the life sciences sector may be your next step.

As Customer Service Representative, you are the first point of contact for customers and the link between them and the teams working behind the scenes. You listen, work out what is needed, and make sure it gets sorted quickly and properly.

What you will do

• Handle customer questions by phone and in writing: orders, billing, cancellations, account queries, complaints and errors

• Welcome customers warmly, understand their issue and either resolve it yourself or route it to the right colleague

• Take in and process orders, and arrange refunds and exchanges where needed

• Create and maintain customer accounts with accurate, up-to-date information

• Support shipping and transport documentation and answer related questions

• Log and follow up on service requests

• Help coordinate product recalls when they occur

• Spot customer needs and share ideas for relevant products or services with management

• Work closely with the commercial team, logistics, Finance, Quality, Regulatory and Legal

As a Customer Service Representative you should have the following characteristics:

• A bachelor’s degree in languages or economics, or equivalent knowledge gained through experience or training

• At least 3 years of experience in a comparable customer service or order management role within an international sales organisation. Experience in medical devices or life sciences is a clear advantage

• Fluent English and Spanish, spoken and written. Dutch or other European languages are a plus

• Solid knowledge of the order process, and hands-on experience with an ERP system (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics AX)

• Good command of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

• Strong telephone skills and a real talent for listening

• An analytical and organised way of working, with careful documentation

• The ability to juggle several tasks, stay calm in a fast-changing environment and handle conflicts constructively

• Good interpersonal skills and the confidence to make an impact

Nice to haves

• Experience with Salesforce CRM

• Knowledge of how to use artificial intelligence in your daily work

In the ever-fascinating world of technology, integration opens endless possibilities. We are here to show companies how integration can empower their digital foundations and fuel business growth. And you have the chance to be at the forefront of the fascinating world of integration with us by joining us as an Integration Engineer.

Who are we?

Meet i8c! An established value within the integration market and part of CornerBriX, the largest integration community in Belgium. i8c is an expert in Hybrid Integration Platforms (HIP), ensuring seamless collaboration between all IT-systems like mobile apps, administrative tools, CRMs, ERPs, Microservices, SaaS platforms, B2B platforms and many more for leading companies in the BeNeLux region.

At i8c, you’ll find a community of integration experts who are here to challenge you, inspire you and support you. You'll always have the freedom to choose your work location, be it at home or one of our remote co-working spaces.

What will your job look like as an Integration Engineer at i8c:

• Take end-to-end ownership for i8c projects, handling development, deployment, and operational maintenance.
• You’ll embrace DevOps principles to achieve optimal uptime and minimize incidents. 
• You’ll learn to master multiple Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP) vendor solutions (IMB, Microsoft, Software AG, TIBCO, Google, Boomi…) establishing new standards and best practices.
• You’ll provide support on a rotational basis as part of a 24/7 standby team, ensuring prompt assistance when required.
• You’ll participate in daily standup meetings 

Who is our i8c Integration Engineer:

• We don't require extensive experience, but eagerness to deep dive into multiple hybrid integration platforms and technologies, such as Software AG webMethods, Tibco Connect, IBM App Connect/API Connect, Microsoft BizTalk and Azure, Google Apigee, and Boomi.
• You are fluent in English, both written as oral.
• You have basic programming experience with Java or .Net, with a focus on back-end development. 
• You are familiar with the concepts and principles of networking, security (DNS, firewalls, HTTP, SSL…) and DevOps (CI/CD, testing…)
• Knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns is a plus, just as experience with collaboration tools such as Atlassian, GitLab,…

Our client operates in the logistics sector, specializing in warehouse operations and inventory management. The company focuses on the efficient handling, storage and distribution of goods. Quality, accuracy and safety are essential in its daily operations. Employees work together to ensure smooth inbound and outbound processes. You will join a professional warehouse environment where teamwork and efficiency are key.
Jobomschrijving

Looking for an opportunity where you can make a visible impact and help shape a growing operation from the ground up? Our client Segex is a new and expanding logistics organization based in Wommelgem, specializing in the storage, packaging, and distribution of healthcare and pharmaceutical products.

As part of an international group this company manages the flow of products from global manufacturers to customers across Central- and South- America, Europe and Asia. The Belgian operation was launched recently and currently employs a small team of around eight people, creating a unique opportunity to join a business in an exciting growth phase.

As Warehouse Supervisor, you will take ownership of the day-to-day warehouse operations and lead the Belgian warehouse team. You will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence while helping build processes and structure within a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate the warehouse team, ensuring smooth daily operations.
• Manage inbound, outbound, picking, packing, inventory, and stock accuracy activities.
• Monitor warehouse KPIs and identify opportunities for operational improvement.
• Act as the local key user for the Warehouse Management System (WMS).
• Coordinate staffing, holidays, absences, and workforce planning in collaboration with local management.
• Ensure compliance with quality, safety, and operational procedures.
• Work closely with the international operations team in headquarters and support the continued growth of the Belgian site.

You enjoy being present on the warehouse floor, taking ownership, and motivating people to achieve operational goals.

Who You Are?

• A natural team leader who leads by example and communicates clearly.
• Structured, hands-on, and solution-oriented.
• Comfortable working in a dynamic international logistics environment.
• Focused on quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.
• Proactive and capable of making operational decisions independently.
must haves

• Minimum 3 years of experience within warehouse or logistics operations.
• Proven experience as a Warehouse Supervisor, Team Leader, or Warehouse Coordinator.
• Experience managing and motivating operational teams.
• Strong understanding of inbound, outbound, inventory management, and warehouse KPIs.
• Hands-on experience with a Warehouse Management System (WMS).
• Good knowledge of international logistics and imported goods flows.
• Professional proficiency in English and Spanish. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a strong asset
